title: The Collapsing Star Canon
summary: A canon of drawing all weight inward on one point until it fails under itself and takes what stands near it down.

title: Treatise of the Doubled Mass
summary: A treatise on doubling and doubling again the weight of body and blow until nothing can stand to receive them.

title: The Great Anchor Mastery
summary: A mastery of anchoring so great that a foe cannot flee and an ally cannot be pulled from the user's side.

title: Manual of Crushing Descent
summary: A manual on loosing a mass from on high so that its descent crushes what lies beneath without recourse.

title: The Inverted Weight Course
summary: A course on reversing the pull in a small space so that weight rises and what was light falls hard.

title: Canon of the Orbit Bound
summary: A canon on binding foes and blows into orbits about the user that tighten with every circuit.

title: The Settling Doom Mastery
summary: A mastery of weight that settles slowly on a foe and does not lift again until the foe is done.

title: Treatise on the Grounded Sky
summary: A treatise on pressing the air so heavily that anything which flies or leaps is dragged to the ground.
